aaf35d04e3a45e8f8889.en: Speech marks show the exact words that someone says. They look like little 66 and 99 shapes.
aaf35d04e3a45e8f8889.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan kata-kata yang persis diucapkan seseorang. Bentuknya seperti angka 66 dan 99 yang kecil.

274e391a9b81e7c371a9.en: Open the speech marks before the first spoken word. Close them after the last one.
274e391a9b81e7c371a9.id: Buka tanda petik sebelum kata pertama yang diucapkan. Tutup setelah kata terakhir.

7f740ec0e0ce08595736.en: The first spoken word starts with a capital letter.
7f740ec0e0ce08595736.id: Kata pertama yang diucapkan dimulai dengan huruf kapital.

7523816ef972e9efd026.en: The punctuation for the speech goes inside the speech marks. Use a comma, a question mark or an exclamation mark.
7523816ef972e9efd026.id: Tanda baca untuk ucapan itu ditulis di dalam tanda petik. Pakai koma, tanda tanya, atau tanda seru.

c1d72fe75badf5322e35.en: You can say who is speaking before or after the spoken words.
c1d72fe75badf5322e35.id: Kamu bisa menyebut siapa yang berbicara sebelum atau sesudah kata-kata yang diucapkan.

7cd1cd41682653dc92c5.en: Lena said I am ready, so those words go inside the speech marks, with the comma.
7cd1cd41682653dc92c5.id: Lena berkata I am ready, jadi kata-kata itu ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks), bersama komanya.

c07dd418fa895ae86ef7.en: Look is the first spoken word, so it needs a capital letter: “Look at the moon.”
c07dd418fa895ae86ef7.id: Look adalah kata pertama yang diucapkan, jadi perlu huruf kapital (capital letter): “Look at the moon.”

f3e582e4e2985f64dbb1.en: Speech marks go around the exact words that someone says.
f3e582e4e2985f64dbb1.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) mengapit persis kata-kata yang diucapkan seseorang.

415843a61eddcfd113dc.en: The words inside the speech marks are the words Sam said: I love kites.
415843a61eddcfd113dc.id: Kata-kata di dalam tanda petik (speech marks) adalah kata-kata yang diucapkan Sam: I love kites.

19ebd81bd88b46dc7f68.en: Joko said Come and play, so those words go inside the speech marks. Called Joko stays outside.
19ebd81bd88b46dc7f68.id: Joko berkata Come and play, jadi kata-kata itu ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks). Called Joko tetap di luar.

8ef74568eb5db2e773e4.en: The question mark is part of Mei's words, so it goes inside the closing speech mark.
8ef74568eb5db2e773e4.id: Tanda tanya (question mark) adalah bagian dari kata-kata Mei, jadi ditulis di dalam tanda petik penutup.

bae65a4b2dea83b8c9bc.en: Dewi's words are inside the speech marks: The bus is late. The words said Dewi tell us who spoke.
bae65a4b2dea83b8c9bc.id: Kata-kata Dewi ada di dalam tanda petik (speech marks): The bus is late. Kata-kata said Dewi memberi tahu kita siapa yang berbicara.

ea706313ca31a7613911.en: In the correct sentences, only the spoken words and their punctuation are inside the speech marks.
ea706313ca31a7613911.id: Pada kalimat yang benar, hanya kata-kata yang diucapkan dan tanda bacanya yang ada di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

306fa8344daaccef4321.en: The spoken words come first, then said Dad. The comma inside the speech marks shows the sentence carries on.
306fa8344daaccef4321.id: Kata-kata yang diucapkan ditulis lebih dulu, lalu said Dad. Koma (comma) di dalam tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan kalimatnya masih berlanjut.

a2333e68d527bc027f46.en: “My shoes are wet,” said Rina shows Rina's exact words in speech marks. Rina said that her shoes were wet tells us about it in other words.
a2333e68d527bc027f46.id: “My shoes are wet,” said Rina menunjukkan persis kata-kata Rina di dalam tanda petik (speech marks). Rina said that her shoes were wet menceritakannya dengan kata-kata lain.

375df793f10ef5d7cf31.en: The exclamation mark is part of the team's words, so it goes inside the speech marks. No extra comma is needed after it.
375df793f10ef5d7cf31.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) adalah bagian dari kata-kata tim itu, jadi ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks). Tidak perlu koma tambahan setelahnya.

cdbc0e0a19161a1a364b.en: The first spoken word starts with a capital letter, so my should be My.
cdbc0e0a19161a1a364b.id: Kata pertama yang diucapkan dimulai dengan huruf kapital (capital letter), jadi my harus ditulis My.

30b1e7a8e6c2d09f47ba.en: Mum's words are Have you fed the fish? Those words and the question mark go inside the speech marks.
30b1e7a8e6c2d09f47ba.id: Kata-kata Mum adalah Have you fed the fish? Kata-kata itu dan tanda tanya (question mark) ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

3b87e3226d64531932d8.en: Kofi's words are split by said Kofi. Each part has speech marks, and we has a small w because the sentence carries on.
3b87e3226d64531932d8.id: Kata-kata Kofi dipisah oleh said Kofi. Setiap bagian punya tanda petik (speech marks), dan we memakai huruf w kecil karena kalimatnya masih berlanjut.

3cce6df1bcb68c57a22c.en: Speech marks go around the words Tom said.
3cce6df1bcb68c57a22c.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) mengapit kata-kata yang diucapkan Tom.

cec4b0caab824666b9ea.en: Come here is inside the speech marks.
cec4b0caab824666b9ea.id: Come here ada di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

b978c5eb7941c7223fbd.en: A question needs a question mark inside the speech marks.
b978c5eb7941c7223fbd.id: Kalimat tanya perlu tanda tanya (question mark) di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

77f816330057f638ed4c.en: Sentences with speech marks show spoken words.
77f816330057f638ed4c.id: Kalimat yang memakai tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan kata-kata yang diucapkan.

72382c38a3ba7bdd41ee.en: Each word tells how someone spoke.
72382c38a3ba7bdd41ee.id: Setiap kata menunjukkan cara seseorang berbicara.

688209d9c11514dd8c98.en: The comma goes inside the speech marks.
688209d9c11514dd8c98.id: Koma (comma) ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

c805c890bc71f43c9c16.en: Dad said, "Come and eat." gives exact words.
c805c890bc71f43c9c16.id: Dad said, "Come and eat." menunjukkan persis kata-kata Dad.

f7d619d522935c7c65e4.en: Speech marks must come in pairs.
f7d619d522935c7c65e4.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) harus selalu berpasangan.

21002913d422ed5f5856.en: Tia asked, "Where is the cat?" uses direct speech.
21002913d422ed5f5856.id: Tia asked, "Where is the cat?" memakai kalimat langsung (direct speech).

1fab8573df81b063b71a.en: Speech marks show us the words spoken. Example: Sam said, "I am hungry."
1fab8573df81b063b71a.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan kata-kata yang diucapkan. Contoh: Sam said, "I am hungry."

0f3fb9da262f1152e7de.en: Only the spoken words go inside the speech marks. The words said Ben are outside.
0f3fb9da262f1152e7de.id: Hanya kata-kata yang diucapkan yang ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks). Kata-kata said Ben ada di luar.

0a386ad4f9f230ff369e.en: Speech marks are also called inverted commas or quotation marks.
0a386ad4f9f230ff369e.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) juga disebut inverted commas atau quotation marks.

cd89049f809ba80a4555.en: It does not give her exact words, so no speech marks are needed.
cd89049f809ba80a4555.id: Kalimat itu tidak menunjukkan persis kata-kata Mum, jadi tidak perlu tanda petik (speech marks).

7937eb93d964081b292b.en: A new speaker needs a new line in a story. This helps the reader follow who is talking.
7937eb93d964081b292b.id: Dalam cerita, pembicara baru perlu baris baru. Ini membantu pembaca mengikuti siapa yang sedang berbicara.

df66460ee65e47b95fa7.en: When spoken words that tell something are followed by said, a comma goes inside the speech marks. Example: "Come here," said Dad.
df66460ee65e47b95fa7.id: Kalau ucapan yang memberi tahu sesuatu diikuti said, koma (comma) ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks). Contoh: "Come here," said Dad.

a6e90ded82247dd73735.en: The spoken words are a question, so we need a question mark inside the speech marks: "Can I have a drink?" asked Lily.
a6e90ded82247dd73735.id: Kata-kata yang diucapkan adalah pertanyaan, jadi kita perlu tanda tanya (question mark) di dalam tanda petik (speech marks): "Can I have a drink?" asked Lily.

cf42b04d2ccb75b24eb2.en: Speech marks go around only the spoken words: "Come here," said Mum.
cf42b04d2ccb75b24eb2.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) hanya mengapit kata-kata yang diucapkan: "Come here," said Mum.
